title: Tetramethylpyrazine Promotes Functional Recovery after Spinal Cord Injury by Regulating 5-Methylcytosine RNA Modification via the NSUN2-XBP1 Axis.
authors: Xiao, Zhiyong; Wang, Zhiyu; Jiang, Honghui; Liu, Yunlu; Guo, Weichun
one_liner_zh: 该文研究川芎嗪通过NSUN2-XBP1轴调控RNA m5C修饰促进脊髓损伤恢复，属纯湿实验与临床前机制研究，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系、无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Spinal cord injury (SCI) is a devastating condition with limited therapeutic options. Tetramethylpyrazine (TMP) has shown therapeutic potential in mitigating SCI-related damage. This study investigates the role of TMP in regulating 5-methylcytosine (m(5)C) RNA modification and its impact on SCI recovery. METHODS: A rat model of SCI was induced via contusion injury, and TMP was administered intraperitoneally for 28 days. Functional recovery was evaluated using the Basso-Beattie-Bresnahan (BBB) locomotor rating scale. Histopathological changes were assessed by hematoxylin-eosin (HE) staining, while inflammatory cytokines (IL-1beta, IL-6, TNF-alpha) and oxidative stress markers (SOD, MDA) were quantified using enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA) and colorimetric assays. In vitro, PC12 cells were exposed to lipopolysaccharide (LPS) to model SCI, and TMP's effects on apoptosis and inflammation were analyzed via flow cytometry and ELISA. Molecular docking, m(5)C RNA immunoprecipitation (RIP), reverse transcription quantitative PCR (RT-qPCR), and luciferase reporter assays were performed to elucidate the interaction between TMP, NSUN2, and XBP1. RESULTS: TMP treatment significantly improved motor function, reduced inflammation, and alleviated oxidative stress in SCI rats. In vitro, TMP dose-dependently reduced apoptosis and inflammatory cytokine levels in LPS-induced PC12 cells. TMP downregulated NSUN2 expression, leading to reduced m(5)C modification of XBP1 mRNA. Overexpression of NSUN2 increased XBP1 stability and expression, while knockdown of NSUN2 or overexpression of XBP1 modulated apoptosis and inflammation in PC12 cells. CONCLUSIONS: TMP promotes functional recovery after SCI by modulating m(5)C RNA modification through the NSUN2-XBP1 regulatory axis. These findings suggest the therapeutic potential of TMP in SCI and provide novel mechanistic insights into the role of RNA modifications in neuroprotection and inflammation regulation.
abstract_zh: 背景：脊髓损伤（SCI）是一种破坏性疾病，治疗选择有限。川芎嗪（TMP）在减轻SCI相关损伤方面显示出治疗潜力。本研究探讨TMP在调节5-甲基胞嘧啶（m(5)C）RNA修饰中的作用及其对SCI恢复的影响。方法：通过挫伤诱导大鼠SCI模型，并腹腔注射TMP治疗28天。使用Basso-Beattie-Bresnahan（BBB）运动功能评分量表评估功能恢复情况。通过苏木精-伊红（HE）染色评估组织病理学变化，同时使用酶联免疫吸附试验（ELISA）和比色法量化炎症细胞因子（IL-1β、IL-6、TNF-α）和氧化应激标志物（SOD、MDA）。在体外，将PC12细胞暴露于脂多糖（LPS）以模拟SCI，并通过流式细胞术和ELISA分析TMP对细胞凋亡和炎症的影响。进行分子对接、m(5)C RNA免疫沉淀（RIP）、逆转录定量PCR（RT-qPCR）和荧光素酶报告基因实验，以阐明TMP、NSUN2和XBP1之间的相互作用。结果：TMP治疗显著改善了SCI大鼠的运动功能，减少了炎症，并减轻了氧化应激。在体外，TMP剂量依赖性地降低了LPS诱导的PC12细胞中细胞凋亡和炎症细胞因子水平。TMP下调NSUN2表达，导致XBP1 mRNA的m(5)C修饰减少。NSUN2过表达增加了XBP1的稳定性和表达，而NSUN2敲低或XBP1过表达调节了PC12细胞中的细胞凋亡和炎症。结论：TMP通过NSUN2-XBP1调控轴调节m(5)C RNA修饰，促进SCI后的功能恢复。这些发现提示TMP在SCI中的治疗潜力，并为RNA修饰在神经保护和炎症调节中的作用提供了新的机制见解。
